question: Can a new KartaView/Jakarta sequence source separately test character-sequence text normalization and query-independent brand appearance without tuning any opened Panoramax or Mapillary row?

source_authority.imagery_license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 according to the official KartaView landing page; retain provider/contributor attribution and derived-artifact provenance during materialization.
source_authority.provider_relation: Provider-disjoint from Panoramax and Mapillary evaluations already opened by the L10 router.
source_authority.city_relation: City-disjoint from Grenoble, Rumilly, Halle, Caen, Rotterdam, and Den Haag router evaluations already opened in this line.

selection_contract.pixel_boundary: Selection used only public KartaView photo/sequence metadata, OSM names/tags, coordinates, headings, sequence order, projection, field of view, capture identity, and timestamps. No selected image URL was downloaded or rendered.
selection_contract.target_ordering: Within the first verified KartaView SPHERE/PLANE coverage neighbourhood returned by the official API, enumerate OSM-named non-road objects and retain the first pair with public active planar sequence frames, target-bearing inside half horizontal field of view, distinct query contributors/sequences, and complementary lexical-versus-appearance development roles.
selection_contract.positive_geometry: A frame is metadata-positive only when great-circle target distance is at most 45 m and absolute wrapped heading-to-target-bearing delta is at most half the sequence camera horizontal field of view.
selection_contract.negative_geometry: A candidate negative control must be public/active, at most 45 m from the same target, come from a different sequence and contributor than its query, and place the target bearing outside half horizontal field of view. Human pixel truth must still confirm target absence before any model call.
selection_contract.no_substitution: After this receipt, the listed target, query sequence, query frame window, and negative-control identity may not be replaced based on pixels, OCR, rank, or truth. An invalid row becomes NOT_EVALUABLE.
selection_contract.opened_cohort_exclusion: No threshold, crop, token rule, suffix rule, OCR preprocessing, appearance gate, or abstention rule may be learned from Panoramax PS/DF or Mapillary MR outcomes.

target.name: Apotik Setia Budhi
target.role_reason: The name is intentionally below the frozen two-unit distinctive-token gate, so this row can develop character-sequence normalization without pretending that the old token rule should already match it.

negative_control.required_truth: Human review must confirm that the target credential is absent before this can serve as a negative.

rows.reference_policy: Lexical-only development row. No appearance reference may be created from the query or its neighbouring frames.

target.name: Alfamidi
target.role_reason: The eight-character brand already meets the frozen two-unit name-capability rule, while the Wikidata brand identity permits a query-independent logo/reference search before query pixels are opened.

negative_control.required_truth: Human review must confirm that the target brand is absent before this can serve as a negative.

rows.reference_policy: Resolve Wikidata Q12471462 to an official or Wikimedia-hosted brand reference, freeze its URL/hash before any query pixel is opened, and treat it only as brand-level appearance evidence, never exact-instance evidence.

frozen_query_independent_reference.license: Public domain according to Wikimedia Commons imageinfo metadata
frozen_query_independent_reference.materialization_boundary: This logo was resolved and downloaded before any KartaView query or negative-control pixel. It provides brand appearance only, never exact-place or entrance identity.

next_frozen_steps: Hash-verify the already frozen query-independent Alfamidi brand reference before every materialization or replay.
Materialize only the six exact query-window photos and two exact negative-control photos through atomic .part files under artifacts.local/datasets/l10-kartaview-jakarta-provider-disjoint-v1.
Obtain independent per-frame human truth for target/credential visibility and confirm both negative controls before any OCR or appearance call.
Develop character-sequence normalization only on KVJ-CHAR-01; keep KVJ-BRAND-01 as the separately routed appearance row and do not use MR outcomes.
Pre-register progressive observation order and abstention before evaluation; any failed source or truth gate returns NOT_EVALUABLE without substitution.
Use a second new KartaView city as confirmation after Jakarta development; Jakarta alone cannot establish city-general transfer.

claim_boundary.allowed: A reproducible metadata-only admission of a new-provider/new-city two-row Development candidate with exact query windows and contributor-disjoint geometric negative-control candidates.
not_allowed: pixel visibility, lexical correctness, appearance correctness, negative validity, or any algorithm metric
independent, provider-general, city-general, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, online, deployment, or safety confirmation
exact facade, portal, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
treating a brand identity or search candidate as an exact place-instance binding
